class.name: PointQuery3DDirect
class.brief_description: A query for colliders intersecting a single point.
class.description: [admonition type="note" collapsible="true" open="false"] [b]Part of [i]Godot Engine: Conservatory Edition[/i].[/b] This is not available in the official build of Godot. [/admonition] This class queries for physics bodies and areas a specific point.

method.name: query
method.description: Performs a query using the properties of this object as parameters. Can return up to [param max_count] items.

method.name: query_statically
method.description: Statically perform a query using the provided [param parameters]. Can return up to [param max_count] items.

method.name: query_statically_preallocated
method.description: Statically perform a query using the provided [param parameters]. This variation of the method is special in that it expects the passed array ([param result_preallocated]) to have its size set [b]before[/b] calling this method. The size of this array is used to determine the number of results. This variation of the method is most optimal, as any instances of results in the array will be overwritten, instead of an entirely new result object being created. The length of the array is not changed by this method, only its contents. Thus, the return value is the amount of results actually hit, so use the return value in a for loop to iterate over all results.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], collisions with physics areas (like [Area3D]) will be reported.
If [code]true[/code], collisions with physics bodies (like [PhysicsBody3D]) will be reported.

The query's collision mask. Only objects in at least one collision layer enabled in the mask will be detected. See [url=$DOCS_URL/tutorials/physics/physics_introduction.html#collision-layers-and-masks]Collision layers and masks[/url] in the documentation for more information.

An array of [RID]s to filter. Depending on the value of [member filter_is_inclusive], this will either be a list of [RID]s that can not be hit (all other objects will be hit except for these), or it's the list of [RID]s that can only be hit (no objects will be hit except for these).
Determines if [member filter] is a whitelist or blacklist for [RID]s.
The position in space where this query will occur.
